_help: Fill in every value below, or delete the key. tools/build_timelines.py copies this file into each timeline, and reel.js reads the palette, fonts and wordmark from there. Keep claims to what the brief or site states.
name: BRAND NAME (exact spelling)

creator.primary: CREATOR NAME IN THE CAPTION LANGUAGE

palette.accentMeaning: action rings mark a user action (Copy, Save); accent marks what to look at

claims: Only facts the brief or the site itself states, one per line
neverSay: Anything stronger than the source, e.g. free / best / no account, unless a claim above says so

voice.disclosure: AI-generated narrator voice. Not the creator.
